left.issue: Shelf price labels are still not all one size. Pencil cases and Footballs (p50_s3, p50_s9) are set at about 7.5 pt and overflow their plates. Calculators, Ballpoint pens, Pens and Rackets are about 5.5 pt, the most their slanted plates hold. The Ballpoint pens and Pens plates (p50_s4, p50_s5) still have rectangular erasures over their outlines; fixing them needs the same restore-and-paint work done here for Calculators and Rackets. The 'Buying Stationery' sign (p50_s1) reads well at its current size and was left as it is.
